<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="POOL" name="Insurance organisation" processRef="CLAIM_PROCESS" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="CLAIM_PROCESS" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_CO" name="Claims officer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>START</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>EXAMINE</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>MERGE_REC</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>WRITE_REC</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_SCO" name="Senior claims officer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>CHECK_REC</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>GW_OK</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>END</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="START" name="Claim registered" />
    <bpmn:task id="EXAMINE" name="Examine the claim" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="MERGE_REC" />
    <bpmn:task id="WRITE_REC" name="Write the settlement recommendation" />
    <bpmn:task id="CHECK_REC" name="Check the settlement recommendation" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="GW_OK" name="Claim marked OK?" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="END" name="Claim handling proceeds" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F1" sourceRef="START" targetRef="EXAMINE" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F2" sourceRef="EXAMINE" targetRef="MERGE_REC" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F3" sourceRef="MERGE_REC" targetRef="WRITE_REC" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F4" sourceRef="WRITE_REC" targetRef="CHECK_REC" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F5" sourceRef="CHECK_REC" targetRef="GW_OK" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F6" name="OK" sourceRef="GW_OK" targetRef="END" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F7" name="Not OK" sourceRef="GW_OK" targetRef="MERGE_REC" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
